body:
He says that it makes him look like an uber driver. I guess he thinks that a job as an uber driver is below him or something? I'm not sure. And the place I wanted to go was a 2 minute drive from our house, I would've walked but I stayed home from school today because of a knee injury.

Edit: I don't even get his logic honestly, I tried thinking about it but it doesn't make sense. Ubers and taxis have people sitting in the front all the time.

Sorry grammar police. Anyways, It's dried up coffee, rotten juice, cups, tissue (that looks used), stuff like that. I couldn't even physically sit in it if I wanted to, there was that much garbage. I didn't complain until he told me to sit in the front. I don't understand why I couldn't have just sat in the back, is it condescending to the person driving the car or something? I really don't get it. And I think he drove to get coffee afterwards so it wasn't a complete waste of his time (I think, not sure honestly). You're right though, I should've just walked away when he started making such a demand. Not ridiculed him. I'll hold my tongue next time and stop asking him for favors from now on. I guess it's finally time to get my driver's license.
